raw_segments.text: Bassanio. Yes, here I tender it for him in the court. Yea, twice the sum. If that will not suffice,
I will be bound to pay it ten times o'er on forfeit of my hands, my head, my heart.
If this will not suffice, it must appear that malice bears down truth. And I beseech you,
rest once the law to your authority. To do a great right, do a little wrong,
and curb this cruel devil of his will.
